senses.definition: A title for someone married to a lord or gentleman.
A title that can be used instead of the formal terms of marchioness, countess, viscountess, or baroness.
(polite or used by children) A woman: an adult female human.
examples: Please direct this lady to the soft furnishings department.

senses.definition: (in the plural) A polite reference or form of address to women.
examples: Ladies and gentlemen, it is a pleasure to be here today. Follow me, ladies!
